blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Public school infrastructure projects across Cebu may receive an additional P261.85 million from the 2026 national budget through the Department of Education (DepEd). This comes after the Cebu Provincial Board authorized Gov. Pamela Baricuatro to sign an addendum to the province’s existing Supplemental Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with DepEd. The amendment […]...
